tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /kun mkhyen dri med 'od zer gyi rnam thar mthong ba don ldan bzhugs so/ /

oṃ swa sti sarba maṃ ga la sing+nghi pha la ho/ /bla ma'i rnam thar mthong ba don ldan zhes bya ba/ brgyud pa gsum gyi bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gis thog mar 'gro don thugs bskyed nas/ /bar du grangs med dbu la khur chen khyer/ /tha mar byang chub mngon par sangs rgyas nas/ /lha mdzes sras mchog lum+ba 'i tshal bltams bzhin/ /skyes mchog 'di yang de yi rjes 'gro ba'i/ /sngon rol bskal pa mang por tshogs bsags nas/ /bar du brtson pa'i go cha mtha' yas shing*/ /tha mar don gnyis mdzad de gtsug gis mchod/ /bdag nyid chen po dri med 'od zer gyi/ /rnam thar nam mkha'i mtha' dang rgya mtsho'i khyon/ /tshu rol blo yis rtogs par dka' na yang*/ bka' drin dran dang phyi rabs don du spro/ /chur nyal tshal na rta bdun shar ba yis/ /rkang drug dga' ston 'phel bar gyur pa ltar/ /bdag blo'i snying gi pad+mo kha phyes la/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i spobs pa bskyed du gsol/ /de yang 'dir skyes mchog de'i bka' drin mi 'dor ba dang*/ phyi rabs skal ldan rnams kyi don du/ chos rje rin po che'i rnam thar mthong ba dang*/ thos pa dang*/ rtogs pa'i tshul mdo tsam zhig yi ger 'god pa la/ bla ma dam pa rnams kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi tshogs rnams kyis stongs grogs mdzod cig /de la bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad gang chen mtsho'i sku'i zhing khams thams cad khyab cing sku la zhing khams thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung du bzhugs pa'i phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi mthil na/ lhung bzed spos chus gtams par me tog nyi shu rtsa lnga brtsegs mar gnas pa'i bcu gsum pa/ thugs ka dpal gyi be'u'i thad pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru gcig gi steng na gzhi dang snying po me tog gis brgyan pa zhes bya ba/ thub pa'i dbang po 'di'i gdul zhing 'dzam gling bye ba phrag brgyar gnas pa la/

gling bzhi las lho phyogs 'dzam gling*/ sa'i lte ba rdo rje gdan las dpag tshad brgya lhag gis bsgrod pa'i sa phyogs g.yo ru gra phu stod grong zhes bya bar/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma'i dngos slob/ dpal rta mgrin gyi grub thob gdung rus ngan lam / mtshan btsun pa rgyal ba mchog dbyangs zhes bya ba de'i gdung rus kyi brgyud pa zam ma chad pa de'i mi rabs nyi shu rtsa lnga song ba na/ a mes lha srung zhes bya ba bdud rtsi sman gyi grub pa thob pa/ dgung lo brgya dang lnga thub pa de'i sras slob dpon bstan pa srung zhes bya ba gcig dang*/ yum mkha' 'gro'i sprul pa 'brog bza' bsod nams rgyan gnyis kyi sras su 'khrungs pa'i ltas la/ yum gyi rmi lam du seṅge chen po gcig gi dpral bar nyi ma gnyis dus gcig la shar ba 'od zer khyil khyil mo rang gi lus la thim pa rmis te/ dus tshod sa pho spre'u'i lo zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes brgyad/ skar ma rgyal 'dzoms pa la sku ba ltams pa'i tshe/ bud med nag mo ral gri thogs pa bzhin dang mche ba gnyer ba zhig na re/ ngas bsrungs ba yin zer nas phyag tu blang*/ slar yum la gtad de mi snang bar gyur to/ /de ni nam gru re ma ti'o/ /yang lan cig yur ma byed dus/ mu khar bsnyal nas yod pa'i tshe/ yum bya ba gcig gis brel nas yod dus/ ser ba babs pas bu chung brjed nas nang du phyin pa dang*/ dran nas zhing khar bltas pas bu chung mi 'dug nas/ ngu zhing nang du yong ba dang*/ sngar gyi bud med nag mo des/ bu chung mdzod nas khyer byung ste/ ral gri brdeg la khad byas nas sprul pa'i sku la brnyas pa byed pa zer nas mi snang bar gyur to/ /rang bzhin dus thams cad du/ nam gru re ma ti gzugs tha dad pa'i sgo nas 'bral ba med par zhabs tog byas so/ /de yang sprul pa'i sku yin par pad+ma'i bka' chems las lung bstan zin pa yin te/ dus kyi tha ma la rgyal ba mchog dbyangs kyi rigs rgyud kyi tha ma la 'jam dbyangs kyis sprul pa gcig gis sngags kyi bstan pa dar bar byed cing*/

de nas yang brgyud pa gnyis kyi bar dar bar byed pa yin te/ ༈ lum+ba'i tshal na don grub bltams pa'i tshe/ /lha dbang klu yi rgyal pos khrul gsol nas/ /dar dkar sle 'us blangs nas shis pa brjod/ / dga' ba'i mdangs phyungs legs par mchod pa ltar/ /skyes mchog 'di yang bltams par gyur ba'i tshe/ /nam gru re ma ti yi phyag gnyis kyis/ /legs par blangs nas bsrung zhing skyob bo zhes/ /slar yang yum la gtad nas mi snang gyur/ /zhes pa ni bltams pa'i tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de ltar chung ngu nas dad pa dang*/ snying rje dang blo gros che zhing*/ dgung lo chu pho byi ba lnga nas 'bri klog zhib par mkhyen/ shing stag bdun la yab las bde gshegs 'dus pa/ rta mgrin/ phur pa/ /gu ru'i phrin las gzhung*/ sman rtsis la sogs pa mkhyen par mdzad/ me 'brug dgung lo dgu la grwa phyi tshong 'dus su/ nyi khri/ brgyad stong pa gnyis brgya tshar bton pas thugs la chud/ sa mo lug dgung lo bcu gnyis la bsam yas su mkhan po bsam rin pa bsam 'grub rin chen dang*/ slob dpon lha kun dga' 'od zer las rab tu byung nas tshul khrims blo gros zhes mtshan gsol te/ 'dul ba bslabs shing*/ bcu gnyis la gral skor dang bshad pa mdzad do/ /zas gtsang sras po khab nas mngon phyung ste/ /rnam dag drung du rab byung bsnyen par rdzogs/ /'khor ba'i nyes dmigs gzigs pa'i tshul bstan nas/ /'gro ba'i kha lo gyen la bsgyur bar mdzad/ /de ltar dam pa 'di yang bsam yas su/ /bstan pa'i gzhi ma 'dul ba yin dgongs nas/ /nyan cing bshad nas phul du phyin par mdzad/ /thub chen rjes 'gro de la gus pas 'dud/ /༈ de nas dgung lo bcu drug la/ slob dpon bkra shis rin chen la/ lam 'bras gnyis dang*/ chos drug gnyis dang*/ phag mo'i chos drug dang*/ bde mchog dril bu pa'i dbang dang bcas pa/ /phyag rdor 'khor lo chen po'i dbang gdams par bcas pa zhus shing*/

slob dpon dbang yes las dus 'khor/ gsar ma'i rgyud 'bum la sogs rgyud sde mang po dang*/ za lung rin po che las zhang tshal pa'i chos skor/ rgod tshang pa'i lam khrid/ dam pa'i zhi byed snga phyi bar gsum/ ma gcig gi gcod rnam drug la sogs pa gsan cing*/ dgung lo bcu dgu me pho stag la gsang phur byon nas/ mkhas pa'i phul du phyin pa bla brang pa chos dpal ldan rgyal mtshan dang chos grags gnyis kyi drung du/ byams pa'i chos lnga/ tshad ma rnams 'grel/ /tshad btus rnams kyi nyan bshad lo drug la zhun thar legs par bcad de/ mgon po byams pa'i rgyud bla mar/ rnam rtog las gzhan de dag gi /spang rgyu gzhan med de yi phyir/ / thos pa de phyir thos pa mchog /ces dang mthun par dam pa de nyid kyis/ thos bsam gnas la blo gros legs sbyangs nas/ /mi shes mun sel rmongs pa'i tshang tshing bsregs/ /shes bya rab gzigs mkhas pa'i pha mthar phyin/ / ces pa 'di yang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de nas skabs 'ga' zhig tu/ mi g.yo ba dang dbyangs can ma shes rab gsal byed la sogs pa'i sgrub pa mdzad pas/ lha so so'i zhal gzigs sha ིnga gsung thos pa dang*/ khyad par dbyangs can ma dang mjal dus/ dbyangs can gyi phyag mthil du bzhag nas gling bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa zhag bdun du gzigs so/ /de nas mgrin pa longs spyod kyi rtsa kha bye ste blo gros phyogs med du rgyas ta ེ / gsang phu la sogs pa'i rig grar bsam yas pa lung mang ba zhes grags so/ /gzhan yang skad gnyis smra ba blo gros brtan pa'i drung du tshad ma sde bdun gyi rnam bshad dang*/ shes rab snying po'i rgya cher 'grel gyi bshad pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal po la sogs pa'i zab mo mdo lnga'i bshad pa dang*/ snyan ngag me long gzhung 'grel la sogs pa mang du gsan no/ /de ltar lung dang man ngag dang*/ rig pa dang snyan ngag dang*/ sdebs sbyor la dbang 'byor pas phyogs tha dad du byon nas/

mkhas grub kyi bla ma du ma las mdo dang rgyud dang man ngag rnams mang du zhus shing*/ slob dpon gzhon nu don grub las rnying ma'i rgyud 'bum/ 'dus mdo sgyu 'phrul sems phyogs la sogs pa mang du gsan no/ /slob dpon gzhon nu rgyal po las bka' dang po bden pa bzhi'i 'grel pa gtam gyi tshogs dang*/ bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i 'grel pa rig pa'i tshogs drug rtsa ba shes rab rig pa drug cu pa/ stong nyid bdun cu pa/ zhib mo 'thag pa rtsod pa bzlog pa/ tha ma don dam nges pa'i 'grel pa chos dbyings bstod pa la sogs pa'i bstod tshogs zhus shing*/ slob dpon gzhon nu rdo rje las spyod 'jug bslab btus jo bo'i bka' gdams skor/ snyan brgyud mang du zhus shing*/ mkhan po pa las khro phu pa'i chos skor/ sgrub thabs rgya mtsho/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ dpal bo rgya mtsho/ chos 'byung brgya rtsa/ 'dul ba lung*/ mdo sde rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ rdo rje gcod pa/ sdud pa/ shes rab snying po/ shes rab khri pa/ tshul lnga bcu pa la sogs pa'i mang po gsan cing*/ chos rje karma pa rang byung rdo rje las sbyor drug gegs sel dang bcas pa/ nā ro chos drug /sku gsum ngo sprod/ thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho/ thugs rje chen po rgyal po lugs/ gsang 'dus/ sam bhu ṭi/ ma hā ma yā/ gshed dmar nag rnams gsan ca ི nga*/ slob dpon dbang yes las sbyor drug bsnyen sgrub yi dam dmar khrid/ sangs rgyas thod pa/ mkha' 'gro gur/ 'jigs byed rwa lugs kyi rgyud rtog pa bdun pa dang*/ gsum pa' ི dbang gdams ngag rdzogs rims dang bcas pa/ rlung 'khor dzaṃ bha la dang*/ ku ru kul+le/ thub pa/ yum sgrub/ byams pa/ gnas brtan bcu drug /sman lha sogs kyi sgrub thabs mang du zhus shing*/ shug gseb rin po che las/ do ha skor gsum/ ri chos skor gsum/ rten 'brel brgya rtsa zhus shing*/ slob dpon ston tshul las drang srong gzhung skyes kyi dngul chu'i bcud len dang bye ma'i bcud len zhus shing*/

bla ma 'jam dbyangs pa las/ dus 'khor sa ris/ memakha' rgya mtsho'i lnga bsdus/ nyi zla gza' 'dzin / brtag gnyis/ rdo rje rtse mo/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud/ rdo rje 'byung ba/ kun dga' snying po'i 'grel pa/ de kho na nyid bsdus pa ta tha saṃ gra ha/ sbyor rgyud/ rdo rje dbyings/ kun rig /rab gnas don gsal la sogs pa zhus shing*/ sa skya pa'i bla ma bdag nyid chen po'i drung du/ thugs bskyed chen mo/ rgyud gsum gyi gdams pa kha tshar zhus shing*/ bla ma khro phu ba las/ rdo rje phreng ba gur mgon dreg mgon la sogs pa zhus shing*/ bla ma 'tshogs 'dus pa las/ chos dbang lugs kyi gsang ba yongs rdzogs thugs rje chen po yang snying 'dus pa/ rdzogs chen sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/ 'khor ba dong sprug/ bla ma gsang 'dus/ mgon po ma ning*/ bcud len brgya rtsa/ rgya mtsho du ru ka'i gtad rgya/ gzo yig pa tra/ me sgyogs chu sgyogs/ dpag chen dpag chung*/ khrom sgrub pa la sogs zhus shing*/ khang dmar pa las/ tshe bdag pā la pa tra/ tsha tsha snyon pa/ tsit+ta dmar po/ ma mo dug gi spu gri/ du ba rlung zhon/ 'bum pa nag po/ mu stegs lha bdun/ rdo rje gcod pa/ ser ba srung 'bebs la sogs pa zhus shing*/ gnyos mthing ma pa las/ bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa/ gnam lcags ur mo/ phur pa gter ma/ ḍāk+ki gsang ba ye shes/ mgon po la ེ bdun ma/ stag zhon/ bya zhon/ seng zhon sgrub thabs la sogs pa zhus shing*/ de yang sngar gsang phur bzhugs dus/ khams pa rnams kyis gnas khang gcig nas gcig tu lan bdun phud pas/ khro phu ba dkon mchog dpal dang lhan cig bzhugs shing yod pa la/ dgung gcig gi skabs su/ bla brang pa chos dpal bzang pos khro phu ba la shog gsung nas/ dge bshes bsam yas pa 'di 'dir chags na gra sa 'di la phan pa zhig 'ong ba 'dug ste/ khams pa ngan pa 'di rnams kyis sdod du mi 'jug pa 'dug pas/ ja 'di khyer la khong gal che ba rnams la drong*/

snam bu 'di gnyis thong*/ khyed kyis lab lab gyis/ nga'i yang lab pa yin gyis gsungs nas/ ja zho phyed dang snam bu gnyis bskur ba khyer nas/ slob dpon pas 'di skad gsung*/ ja 'di 'thung byas pas/ ja sang btung bas chog /do dgongs mi khom par yod zer nas gshegs so/ /phyir nang tho reng khres po bsgrogs nas nged 'gro ba yin/ nga'i shul na khong rnams zo zhig gsungs nas bzhud do/ /grogs po gcig yar byung ba dang lo tsā ba chen po'i sku 'bum rtsar 'phrad byung bas/ khyod 'gro ba i yin zer bas/ nga khams pa'i thad du sdod sa mi 'dug pas 'gro zer/ khyod rtsom pa la ni thogs pa med/ khong rnams la ngan smras kyi tshigs bcad cig 'jog rgyu yin nam zer bas/ shog bu bre kha gang la shong thang zhig bris nas chos khrir bslan yod/ da dung 'di nas dum gcig bskur bas/ 'di khyer cig gsungs nas rkyen la khams 'dus pa ka kha sum cu mdzad nas yar bskur / khong rnams kyis chos kyi khri'i yig ngan de dar du ma ster/ ka kha sum cu 'di rgya yul yan chod du dar bar gyur to/ / de nas skabs gcig tu dbur stod la yar bsod snyoms la byon pa la/ na bza' la yang chos sham stod thung bod phrug dung kha'i phyam tse tho re pa zhig dang / mtha' gnyis su ma lhung ba tsam las med/ cha mda'i yul khang zhig tu bzhugs pa'i nub mo dbus stod nas yong pa'i dge bshes gcig kyang der bsdad 'dug pa de na re/ khyed gang nas yin zer/ nga gsang phu nas yong ba yin byas pas/ slob gnyer ci byas zer bas/ 'dul ba dang*/ byams chos lnga/ tshad ma la sogs pa shes/ khyed gang nas yin gsungs pas/ nga rgya ma nas yin/ yul ni zol phug pa/ btsun pa ni bya yul du byas/ slob gnyer ni dbu ma 'jug pa legs po zhig shes zer bas/ 'o na rgya ma na grub thob lcog la'i sgrub khang brag khung zhig yod zer ba de ci 'dra zhig yod gsungs pas/ brag khung legs po zhig yod ci byed zer/

bsod snyoms la nas rkyal pa bzang ba gang rnyed na/ der dgun bzhugs gcig byas na bsams gsungs pas/ 'o na nga yang dgun der 'dug /nga la skor 'di na tshar nas bsdu rgyu 'ga' zhig yod/ ngas zhabs tog byed zer/ grong der sngags pa bu phrug ma ི sos pa zhig 'dug pas/ khyed kyis rta mgrin nag po'i sbyin bsregs e shes zer/ shes gsungs pas/ 'o na nga can byon zer nas sbyin bsregs mdzad pas/ nas rkyal pa bzang ba gang phul/ de nas dge bshes de dang bsdongs nas lcog la'i brag khung du byon/ zla ba brgyad du mtshams byed pa'i dam bca' mdzad/ mun khang zhig mdzad nas bzhes pa der drangs/ tho rangs kyi thun la dge bshes de la phar phyin thun che ba re gsung*/ zla ba lnga song ba'i tho ra ེ sa khar/ nam mkhar sil snyan gyi sgra dang*/ glu dbyangs snyan po gsan nas gzigs pas/ lung pa'i mda' na bye ma'i ri chung dang*/ 'bab chu gcig yod pa'i sa nas yar/ rta gsar khrab dang dril bu g.yer khas brgyan pa zhig la/ bud med lo bcu drug ma'i na tshod tsam za 'og gi gos dang*/ gser g.yus brgyan pa/ gser gyi pa tras gdong g.yogs pa zhig zhon nas byon pa'i thu ba la 'jus nas 'phags ma thugs rjes 'dzin par zhu zhus pas/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan gcig 'dug pa de phud nas khong gi mgo la bskon nas/ dus 'di nas bzung ste byin gyis brlab cing dngos grub sbyin par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs nas/ de'i byin brlabs kyis zla ba gcig gi bar du/ bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin phyam brdal

/ rig 'dzin chen po ku ma rā dza dang mjal pa'i lung bstan yang thob/ de nas mtshams bkrol nas yab yum gyi don du kun rig gi cho ga brgya rtsa brgyad mdzad/ slob dpon la bsta ེ na tshul gyi cho ga yang 'di tsam mdzad pas byin brlabs yong nges snyam nas dbang zhus pa'i zhu ba byas/ des chog gsungs/ slob dpon chu len du song ring*/ tshon rtsi tshos mongs dang*/ rtsig pa bya cag ma byed pa'i lcog gi ldel ka dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor legs pa gcig bzhengs tshar 'dug na sngags pa phyug po bza' tshang 'khor gcig dang*/ pho mo sum cu tsam gyis dbang zhus so/ /kye ma kye hud mgon po thugs rje can/ /mi mngon dbyings nas bdag la gzigs mdzod la/ /ngag gi dbang po'i mkhyen rab 'od stong gis/ / bdag blo'i snying gi mun pa myur du sol/ /de nas dgung lo nyer bdun la/ rig 'dzin chen po'i drung du 'byon pa la bsam yas na mar byon par/ g.yag sde paṇa chen dang 'phrad pas/ da khyod gar 'gro thams cad chos rje karma pa las chos zhu ba la yar 'tshogs pas der 'gro na 'thad zer ba la/ nga yar stod rgyam gyi phu na rig 'dzin chen po ku ma rā dza bzhugs zer ba la mjal du 'gro ba yin gsungs nas/ rgyam phur byon pas rig 'dzin chen po dpon slob rnams sbra phya ther bdun cu tsam mdzad nas bzhugs pa dang mjal/ bla ma'i zhal nas mdang lha'i bya yin zer pa'i bya ya mtshan can gcig la bya bran stong gis bskor nas nga'i dpe cha khyer nas phyogs tha dad du song ba rmis/ de khyed la lta ba yin par 'dug /nga'i chos 'di'i brgyud pa 'dzin pa zhig yong bar 'dug gsungs nas dgyes tshor chen po mdzad/ 'di dus dgung lo nyer bdun 'gro gsungs/ dpyid ka 'i b.rabaka' chos sgugs nas zhes pa'ang 'dug der lung stong gcig nas gcig tu lan dgu 'pho skyas byas nas/ gzhi re zin dus skyas re byas pas lus ngag la gzan par byung*/ gos ngan pas nye gnas btsun chung 'ga' yod pa dang*/

bskor khyi yang sdang bar byung*/ khrid sang nyin 'dzugs pa'i do dgongs khrid gnyer ba gnyis kyis tshogs bre chen po zhig khyer nas/ dge bshes bsam yas pa'i chos khral gar yod / dbang gang rgyud dang bcas pa zhu ba la nas khal bdun re dgos pa yin zer bas/ nga la ni bre gang yang med chos thob par byed pa yin gsungs pas bsdad pa yin byas pas/ khrid pa 'di tsam gcig gi chos khral sus 'jal zer ba dang*/ skye ba snga ma tshogs ma bsags pas dka' las de tsam zhig byas pas/ chos khral la sdug nas 'gro dgos pa 'dug pas mi la ngo tsha / nam langs tsa na lung pa 'di'i mdor slebs pa byed dgos dgongs nas/ tho rangs bzhengs kyin yod tsa na/ dge bshes bsam yas pa khyed da lta chos rje'i drung du shog gsungs zer bas/ nge da rang 'gro rtsis yin yang gsung bcag na mi nyan dgongs nas zhabs drung du phyin pas/ zhal 'dzum mdzad nas/ spra spro ma byed par bzhugs la ja 'thung gsung*/ khrid gnyer ba gnyis shog gyis gsungs nas/ tsha ba gnang ba'i gral du dge bshes 'di'i chos khral nang nas 'debs pa yin khong ma gtser/ nga la da res kyi chos nyan 'di tsho thams cad las khong dga' ba yin gsung*/ /e ma ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i tshul/ /chos 'phags drung du rtag ngu mjal pa dang*/ /byams mgon drung na thogs med mjal ba ltar/ /dam pas dam pa brten pa 'di ni mtshar/ phye bre gsum dang dngul chu ril bu nyi shu rtsa gcig gis zla ba gnyis kyi gsol ba mdzad cing*/ kha ba babs dus sgye nang du bzhugs nas/ gos gdan gnyis ka'i go bcad cing*/ chos phyogs su dka' ba mang du spyad nas/ bla ma'i drung du chos bka' yang mang bar gsan nas/ gter ma nyang lugs kyi gu ru zhi drag byin rlabs lu gu rgyud/ bka' brgyad phag nag dmar po la sogs pa' ི sgrub thabs mang po dang*/ kun byed rgyal po/ a ro nam mkha' rlung 'byams/ kun bzang che ba rang gnas/ srid pa'i 'bebs chen mo/

klong chen rab 'byams kyi shes bya mtha' gcod/ phyi skor nang skor gsang skor gyi rgyud mang po dang*/ khyad par gsang ba bla na med pa'i dbang bzhi/ zab mo pod bzhi phran tsheg dang bcas pa/ rgyud bcu bdun ṭi ka dang bcas pa/ man ngag brgya dang bcu dgu phran tsheg dang bcas pa/ bka' srung e ka tsa ti'i sgrub thabs legs ldan lcam dral/ gza' bdud dang*/ dam can gyi sgrub thabs skor dang bcas pa la sogs zhus shing*/ bstan pa dam pa'i cha lugs ma lus pa/ bka' yi bstan pa'i babs rjes gnang dang bcas nas gnang bar mdzad de bstan pas/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas/ chos kyi rgyal por gyur cing gang gis mthong ba dang*/ thos pa dang*/ dran pa dang*/ reg pa thams cad gdod ma'i sa la 'god pa'i mthu chen po mnga' ba yin no/ /gdod ma'i mgon dang rnam dbyer mi phyed cing*/ /'gro ba'i don du thugs rjes thabs chen 'gyed/ /theg mchog snying po'i char rgyun rgya che bas/ / skal bzang lta spyod lo tog rgyas mdzad bstod/ / de nas mchims phur lo bdun gyi bar dam bca' sgrub pa mdzad dus/ lhun grub sgang du phag mo nag mo'i zhal zhag bdun mthong*/ de nas o rgyan drag sgrub/ che mchog dbu nyi shu rtsa gcig phyag bzhi bcu zhe gnyis pa la bka' brgyad kyi lha tshogs bdun brgya nyi shu rtsa lngas bskor ba skabs skabs su gzigs so/ /gnod sbyin dzaṃ lhas nor bu gcig phul ba dang*/ rdo rje g.yu sgron mas zhal bstan nas/ rang gi phyi sgrub nang sgrub gsang sgrub bla na med pa dang bcas pa'i sgrub lugs phul lo/ / dge'u gong du bzhugs dus gu ru zhi ba'i zhal gzigs/ mkha' spyod du byon nas mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis chos 'chad lugs rnam thar rnams gzigs shing*/ bkra shis me tog 'thor ba dang*/ 'byon dus mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis skyel thung byas te/ mkha' 'gro snying thig gi rjes gnang phul lo/

/dge 'ur bzhugs dus phag mo dmar mo dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ rta mgrin/ sgrol ma/ tshe dpag med bzhengs stabs rnams 'od dkyil nas zhal gzigs so/ /dur khrod du bzhugs dus las kyi mkha' 'gro ma e ka tsa ti spyan gcig ma/ spyang mo zhing dbyug can mthing mo/ gza' bdud/ rdo rje legs pa rnams gzigs so/ /bya 'ug lha khang du mgon po phyag bzhi pa/ rdo rje bdud 'dul/ dge bsnyen nyer gcig gzigs so/ /chos khams dge ba rgya mtsho'i gos can gzhir/ /byang chub sems mchog bzang po'i sa lud bran/ /smon dang 'jug pa'i sa bon legs btab nas/ /dge bcu'i lo thog gsar du smin mdzad bstod/ /de'i dpyid sor jo bo mjal du byon pas jo bo'i mdzod spu nas 'od zer spros pa / nyid kyi mdzod spur thim pas/ bya rgod phung po'i ri dang*/ li'i yul dang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta ma hā mu tra bya bar sku 'khrungs pa dang*/ rgya gar du mkhyen pa'i chos gsar rnying la sogs pa thugs la bkra lam pa zhig gsal bas thugs rab tu bde ba zhig byung*/ dan phag tu byon nas gsang snying gsan te mar lam res mo dgon par byon nas/ bla ma res mo ba dang gsung gleng mdzad par/ bud med nag mo gcig gis po ti gcig khyer byung nas gzigs pas/ ḍāk+ki tsit+ta bya ba zhig 'dug de'i 'phro la mi snang bar gyur to/ /de la bla ma res mo ba ngo mtshar skyes nas chos zhus pas/ mchims phur snying thig gsung ba'i zhal bzhes mdzad nas byon no/ / dgung lo nyi shu rtsa brgyad la bzhes pa 'bri khung chos kyi rgyal po sku 'khrungs pa dang dus mtshungs pa shing phag lo yin dgos/ mthong snang 'od dra las dgung lo so gnyis la gsungs pa mdzad 'dug de ltar na sa mo yos yin/ ra mo can du snying thig gsungs pas chos 'dzugs pa'i sar me tog gi char babs/ spros bcas kyi tshe 'od mthing kas thams cad brdal bar khyab cing/ spros med kyi dgongs mo 'od zer kha dog lngas khyab cing*/

o rgyan sku mdog mthing kha dang*/ ye shes mtsho rgyal dmar mo phyag na bum pa bsnams nas/ khong rang la dbang bskur dus nam mkha' la/ 'od dang sgra dang*/ sil snyan dang*/ ngo mtshar ba mang po byung zhing*/ dkyil 'khor gyi rtsar bu mo lo bcu drug tsam g.yu ltar sngo ba bdun byung nas/ bro 'khrab pas ched du dgyes pa dang mi dgyais pa la sogs pa ma mdzad gsung*/ 'di'i dus su o rgyan yab yum 'khor dang bcas pas mkha' 'gro snying thig gi rjes gnang*/ lha ring brag dang / o rgyan rdzong dang*/ zhwa'i lha khang gso dgos pa dang*/ bstan bcos rtsom pa'i lung bstan yang thob/ mtshan yang o rgyan gyis dri med 'od zer btags/ ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis rdo rje gzi brjid ces gsol to/ /de yang a ti bkod pa chen po dang*/ sgra thal 'gyur rtsa ba'i rgyud nas/ de 'og blo gros mchog gis 'dzin/ /zhes pa ni chos rje rin po cher bzhed/ bka' chems las/ blo gros ming can thogs med bya bzhin rgyu/ / zhes gsungs so/ /skyes bu 'di ni 'phags chen mchog la dbang*/ /rgyal bas lung bstan chos bdag rnams kyis bstod/ /mkha' 'gro rnams kyis zab gter bdag por bskos/ 'di 'dra'i mkhas grub dam pa gzhan su zhig /de nas gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul du byon nas bstan ma bcu gnyis lha rabs mched dgu rnams kyis bsu ba mdzad pa'i snang ba byung ngo*/ / lo gsum sgrub pa mdzad cing bzhugs dus/ tho rangs kha zhig ga ི rmi lam na bla ma ku ma rā dza byon nas sdig mdzub gcig mdzad de/ ci yang mi gsungs pas dbang gi brda ru go ba dang*/ 'di dus gshegs rtags byung yang*/ ting nge 'dzin gcig gis tshe 'phel ba yin gsung*/ de'i nyi ma rtse shar la mngon sum gzigs dus/ shar phyogs kyi nam mkha' las sgra zhig grags pa/ de'i dus nam mkhar gzigs pas/ 'od kyi dkyil 'khor tshom bu dang bcas pa'i dkyil du kun bzang yab yum dang*/

zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor mang po sa gzhi bar snang steng 'og phyogs mtshams gang bar gzigs pa dang*/ bi ma la sku mdog ljang ser dang mkha' spyod kyi bla ma bzhi/ bla ma ku ma rā dza longs spyod rdzogs pa'i cha byad dang*/ o rgyan pad+ma rgyal po'i cha byad can gzigs pa dang*/ de nas bzung lha'i zhal mang po rgyun chad med par gzigs gsung*/ de nas bod kyi ri bo rtse lngar byon dus 'ja' dang 'od kyi gur mang po phub nas ya mtshan gyi rtags mang po byung zhing*/ sgyu 'phrul skor gyi cho ga mdzad pas zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor nam mkha' dang brag la sogs pa thams cad du tshom bu gsal bar kun gyis mthong ba dang*/ dar cig snang ba 'gyur nas/ shar lho'i mtshams su gzigs pas/ nam mkhar bi ma la bzhugs nas phyag mdzub shar lho 'i mtshams su bstan pa gzigs pa dang*/ lha khang gso ba'i sngar gyi lung bstan rjes su dran no/ /de lta'i skyes bu khyu mchog de'i yon tan brjod pa/ khrom nas chos bshad gaṅgā'i chu rgyun 'dra/ /rig grwar rtsod dus 'brug sgra sgrogs pa 'dra/ /bstan bcos rtsom dus ri gzar 'bab chu 'dra/ /mnyam par 'jog dus rnal 'byor mngon sum 'dra/ /zhes pa don la gnas pa'o/ /'di dus gter lung las/ o rgyan gyi slob dpon gyis/ 'bri gung sgom pa kun ri na la/ 'bri zhes bya ba'i sa phyogs su/ /kun dga'i ming can bdud kyi bu/ /lus la mtshon cha'i ri mo yod/ /shi nas dmyal bar skye bar 'gyur/ /lho yi phyogs nas 'jam dbyangs kyi/ / sprul pa gcig gis thul gyur na/ /mnar med gnas nas thar bar 'gyur/ / zhes pa de sgom pa kun rin gyis mthong ba dang*/ lus la bltas pas rgyab kyi sgal gzhung g.yas su ral gri 'dra ba'i sha mtshan cig 'dug pas ngas dbus gtsang 'khrug pa zhig bya dgos bsam pa yod kyang*/ dmyal bar 'gro na byed don chung bas/ bla ma dpal mchog pa la 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa gcig 'tshol la shog

/ chos zhu yin gsungs pa dang*/ bla ma dpal mchog ba dbus gtsang du 'tshol du byon pas/ dbus gtsang na bla ma rgyal sras pa las thugs rab che ba mi 'dug pas/ sgom pa kun rin la kun mkhyen pa gdan drang byas pas/ khyed dad pa skyes pa na nga dad pa skye ba yin pas de ltar bya'o gsungs so/ /de nas 'bri gung du 'byon par zhal bzhes mdzad dus/ mnal lam du seng ge bzhi'i khri'i steng na bi ma la bzhugs nas nga ni ku ma rā dza'i sprul ba yin/ pad+ma brtsegs pa'i zhing du 'gro sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar bar gyis shig gsungs/ yang de'i sang dgongs phag mo lcags gdong ma/ khong gi gzims sa'i mdun gyi rgya mthongs khar byon pa/ bla ma ku ma rā dza'i sprul pa yin par mkhyen pa dang*/ yang bstan pa'i gnyer gtad do/ /'di'i dus su mya ngan 'das chung mdzad do/ /'khor gsum yongs su dag pa lan gnyis su/ 'bul ba lnga dang bdun gyis bla ma'i gshegs rdzong mdzad kyang*/ bla ma'i phyi rten nang rten la 'od gsal snying po'i bstan pa mi nub par bya ba'i phyir du/ theg mchog rin po che'i mdzod brtsams pa dang*/ de dus sngags bdag gza' dang dam can rnams dang dngos su mi dang mi lab pa bzhin byung ba dang*/ las sgrub pa dang lung bstan pa dang bka' srung ba la sogs pa yang mdzad do/ /ji ltar mtshan mo dngas pa'i nam mkha' las/ /ri bong 'dzin pa shar bas ku mud ta/ dgod pa bzhin du kha bye lhag ger gsal/ /zhar la rgyu skar tshogs rnams dman par gyur/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir 'jam dbyangs sprul pa mchog /kun mkhyen byon pas skal ldan mchog tu rgyal/ /zhar la bla ma'i gzugs brnyan rnams kyang nyams/ / yon tan mchog gis dman rnams zil gyis gnon/ de ltar sngar bsam yas su bzhugs dus ya bo dbang rgyal zhes bya bas/ gdan drangs nas zhag bdun du kun rig gi dbang zhus/ snying tig gi khrid zhus pa'i snga shos glu mkhan pa bsod nams seng ges byas/

phyogs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'dus pa rnams kyi snga shos slob dpon gzhon nu sangs rgyas kyis byas te/ yon bdag la snga shos ya bo dbang rgyal/ bu slob kyi snga shos glu mkhan pa bsod nams seng ge /dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'du ba'i snga shos slob dpon dpal mchog ces bya bar grags shing*/ rgya ma pa dkon gnyer gyis glu mkhan bsod nams seng ge la/ khyod kyis ma bskor pa'i sa cha med pas rdzogs chen la su mkhas par 'dug /ngas zhu 'dod pa yin zhes zer ba la/ ngas dbus gtsang gi bla ma ma mjal ba med/ rdzogs chen pa yang mang po snang ste/ nged rang dang nye ba'i sa phyogs zhig na yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen khyad par du rdzogs pa chen po la mkhas pa zha ི ga bzhugs zer bas/ khong gdan 'dren pa la btang nas rgya ma'i gnas su gdan drangs/ rgya ma sgang pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa rnams dang*/ dkon gnyer gyis snying tig zhus pa'i tshe/ khong rnams dri ba la rgyugs nas bgro gla ེ nga byed par zhus pas/ de de ltar bgyi/ rig grwa sogs zla ba gcig gi bar du khyed rnams la rtsod rgyu yod pa yin/ zhag bcu tsam gyi bar du mdo rgyud dpang por bzhag nas lung rig gi sa rtsod pa byed gsungs pas/ khong rnams spobs pa med par gyur nas nged rnams kyis ma go bar 'dug pas/ chos thugs la 'dog par zhu zer zhing thams cad 'dun par gyur/ dbus stod du sgom pa kun rin gyis gdan drangs nas/ byon pa dang grog gi mdar phyags phebs dus/ te sgro'i las kyi ḍāk+kis bsu ba mdzad cing o rgyan dgon pa phul lo/ / de nas zhwa'i lha khang

du byon dus/ mi dkar po zhwa dkar po can cig byung nas zhwa phud de phyag byas shing*/ zhwa'i lha khang la sdigs mdzub zhig mdzad cing 'dug go/ / dgung lo zhe gnyis bzhes pa sa mo glang gi lo yin bya ba rtsis kyi yi ge zhib mor bris 'dug / tshes bcu'i dus su mkha' 'gro 'du tshogs mang bar gzigs so/ /de nas zhwa'i lha khang gso dus dbu rtse'i rgyab nas gser 'gu tshe gang bcus nas/ gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i cha rkyen dang lha rnams kyi sku gser byas/ gter kha mang bar 'dug kyang rgya mthongs 'og nas sngags bag re tsam dang*/ sgrub thabs thor bu dang*/ gzo yig pa tra dang*/ bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi sgrub thabs dang*/ dam can gyi sgrub thabs tsam las gzhan ma blangs gsung*/ sa rdo bsal dus / mnan pa'i thod pa mang po 'phar zhing byung ba/ na bza' g.yab pas bzung zhing slar gnon pa dang*/ de'i dus legs nyes kyi gtam mi dgos / gza' dang rdo rje legs pas mang du bshad pa byung*/ nyin bzhin du bu tsha g.yu rna can lo brgyad pa tsam zhig /bzo rig pa rnams kyi rtsar slebs nas gro'i skabs su gar song cha med la 'gro yin 'dug par/ thams cad kyis ci yin bgros te sang nyin gro'i dus na gar song blta dgos zhes thams cad mthun par smras so/ /gro la 'gro ba'i dus su bsrungs pas/ rtsig pa'i gseb tu thim nas gar song cha med/ 'di na ི dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i thugs rjes gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i stong grogs dam can rdo rje legs pas mdzad par mngon no/ /lung pa nas brag la brkos pa'i rdo ring chen po mnyam pa gnyis yod pa la/ gcig cung zad chag nas gnyis ka la zhwa'i sa cha'i thob rigs gzong gis brkos nas yod pa las/ phyis gtsug lag khang bzhengs dus rtsa ba 'gyel ba la song nas/ shing bzo'i 'phrul dang*/ mi lag gad ེ ngas pas thag 'gyogs 'debs pa'i 'phrul ci byas kyang bslangs ma nus/ chos rje nyid kyis gtor ma zhig mdzad bden pa'i tshig brjod nas/

sku chos kyi g.yab mo brdul bas rdo rings bsrangs par gyur te/ ngo mtshar ba'i cho 'phrul du bstan/ de nas mtha' dmag gi 'byung po thams cad yun ring du mnan nas sngar gyi mnan pa'i sems can rigs mi gcig pa mang po'i thod pa'i nang gi laṅgi gso dgos pa rnams gsos/ mnan pa mdzad pa'i grabs mdzad pa'i tshe sa rdo'i char babs rlung nag gi 'tshub ma g.yos te rtsub 'gyur cher byung bas/ mi rnams skrag cing brgyal nas mnan pa byed pa'i grogs ma byung*/ chos rje pa nyid kyis he ru ka'i gar dang saṃ kṛ ta'i skad mang po mdzad pa'i tshe/ thod pa rnams sa las 'phar ba gcig la gcig brdabs pa'i skad byung*/ thod pa che shos gcig nam mkha' la 'phar zhing 'dug pa/ zhabs g.yon pas mnan nas/ gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan par mdzad pa'i tshe/ kun mkhyen bsod nams bzang pos gu ru drag po'i skur mthong nas/ thod pa rnams phra men mchod rten gyi zhabs su mnan no/ /stobs chen 'di yi mdzad pa mtha' yas kyis/ /drag pos 'dul la khro zhing gtum par ston/ /zhi bas 'dul la dgyes pa'i zhal bzang 'dzum/ /mdor na rdzu 'phrul cho 'phrul dpag tu med/ / de nas rab gnas mdzad pa'i dus su kun tu bzang po'i skur gyur nas 'dug pa dang*/ thugs ka nas 'od zer mang po 'phros pa las/ 'od zer re re'i rtse la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' grangs med pa bzhugs pa las can gyi slob ma 'ga' yis mthong ba dang*/ la stod dbang rin bya bas me tog thams cad sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas gtor ba yang mthong ngo*/ khong rang gi thugs nyams la/ bcom ldan 'das thub pa dang/ byams pa dang*/ gnas brtan bcu drug rnams zhal mdzum lhag lhag mthong gsung ngo*/ / byams pas phyag mdzub gdengs nas lung bstan pa/ khyed skye ba gnyis 'das pa'i 'og tu/ pad+ma brtsegs pa'i zhing du byang chub sems dpa' ri rab mar me'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya bar 'gyur ro/

/zhes gsungs pa'i lung bstan thob bo/ /skye ba sngon nas rgyal ba rgya mtsho la/ tshogs chen rab bsags lhag par mnyes bgyis pas/ /tshe 'dir sangs rgyas bstan pa'i khur khyer nas/ /rgyal bas lung bstan mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ / spre'u lo'i tshes bcu mdzad pa'i tshe/ nam mkha' 'od phung gi dkyil du o rgyan sku mdog dkar po ḍāk+ki sdai lngas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phro ba zhig gzigs so/ /mi khri bzhi stong 'dus pa las/ te sgro'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams der lhags nas/ mkha' 'gro babs pa bcu phrag lnga bcu byung nas legs nyes thams cad smra ba dang*/ mon bum thang du 'byon par yang lung bstan to/ / der zhwa pad+ma dbang chen gyi rab gnas tshar nas/ ta ེ sgro la byon nas zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar du zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas bskang gso brgya rtsa mdzad de/ bar skabs su+u ma jo gnyis dam sel byas pas gnas de nyams 'dug pa gsos/ mis mi thar pa'i brag la chos rje nyid kyis rgya mtshan dang cod pan btsugs so/ /de nas shug gseb tu byon nas bzhugs dus/ gsal snang zhig la jo mo kha rag gi rgyab nas lus po med pa'i khro bo'i mgo bo ri bas che ba zhig mig 'phrul 'phrul/ kha nas glog 'khyugs pa zhig 'dug pa dang*/ yar klungs zo thang gong po ri nas/ de las che ba'i mgo bo nag po zha ི ga byung nas mig 'phrul zhing kha nas 'od 'phro bas/ 'od de jo mo kha rag gi mgo de'i thad nas yar song ba dang*/ kha rag gi mgo bo de med par 'od de la stod nas yal song bas/ bod khams kun ser ba dang*/ rdo'i char pa dang*/ glog dang*/ 'od kyi khyom khyom 'dug pa dang*/ dus mi bde ba yong mthar 'bros pa yin gsungs nas/ yer pa la so nam zhig bya bsam pa dang*/ lha sar ma ṇi'i khang bu zhig brtseg bsams pa yin te/ da res mi 'grub par gda' bas/ nged rang dpon slob tsho bum thang du 'gro gsungs nas zhal ta mang du mdzad do/

/dbus gtsang 'di na nad mug mtshon gsum dar/ /'di 'dra'i sa char sdod pa mi rigs pas/ /lung bstan bzhin du glo mon 'dul bar dgongs/ /dus gsum rnam mkhyen de la gus phyag 'tshal/ / de nas lha sar byon dus/ 'di 'bṛ gung pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma yin zer nas/ yar klung pas bkrong pa'i rtsis byas dmag gis bskor nas bkrong par brtsams pa la thun mong gi dngos grub brgyad kyi ya gyal/ mi snang ba'i rdzu 'phrul mdzad pas/ btsal byung yang ma mthong bas/ de bros nas mi 'dug zer zhing*/ khong rnams kyis glag ma rnyed do/ /skyes chen 'di ni dngos grub gzugs sprin che/ /rdzu 'phrul thogs med chos skyong las rnams sgrub/ /de 'dra'i mdzad spyod su yis 'gran par nus/ / rtsod med grub chen de la gus phyag 'tshal/ / lha sa'i bar khang na bzhugs shing*/ jo bo'i mdun du bzhugs pa las/ jo bo'i sku las gser lta bu'i 'od zer 'phro ba dang*/ jo bo'i dbu'i steng 'od kyi nang na sangs rgyas rabs bdun/ sman bla sgrol ma dkar sngon bde mchog /dgyes rdor spyan ras gzigs rgyal po lugs phyag stong spyan stong*/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho rnams kyi mtha' na/ mgon po ber nag can dang*/ rgyal chen bzhi dang*/ mgon po seng gdong*/ dpal ldan lha mo rnams bzhengs nas/ nam mkhar gzigs shing 'dug pa gzigs so/ /de'i nyin par brag lha klu phug tu byon nas/ nyin dang mtshan du rin po che gcig thugs la wal wal byung nas/ mtshan mo mnal lam du gangs ti se dang*/ tsā ri shel ri rnams su byon nas legs par gzigs pa zhig rmis gsung*/ de nas lho ru byon dus/ pho ma skyong thang du dge bsnyen nyer gcig dang*/ dmu ra ི sa bsu ba byas/ spyan gzigs drangs pa yang byung*/ yang bum thang du byon dus dge bsnyen nyer cig gis bsu ba byas 'ja'i gur phub/ 'od zer dra ba 'brel/ skyes mchog dam pa mi yi seṅge des/ /sangs rgyas bstan la ston pa'i bya ba mdzad/

/cher 'bag cher 'tshengs chung 'bag chung du 'tshengs/ /thar lam ston mdzad de la gus phyag 'tshal/ / gzhan yang gdul bar dka' ba'i phyogs glo mon dge sdig mi shes shing*/ gsod gcod la dga' ba chos ma dar ba'i sa phyogs rnams su yang*/ 'gro ba sems can rnams rjes su 'dzin pa'i slad du/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams kyis de dag zil gyis mnan nas/ ri rgya dang klung rgya dang*/ lam rgya mdzad nas/ thams cad bde 'jam gyi lam la bkod de/ byang chub kyi sa bon thebs par mdzad ca ིnga byams pa lha khang du phyag phebs pa dang*/ thar pa'i gling du gzigs pas/ ri rtse la 'od kyi 'khor lo zhig gzigs/ thar pa'i gling du bzhugs dus/ lho phyogs kyi mtsho nag po gcig gi nang nas/ g.yag rog po gcig thon byung bas/ ri bo 'degs pa dang du ba 'thul ba la sogs pa'i cho 'phrul byung bas/ sa 'dul ba'i rten 'brel mang po mdzad/ mon bum thang chos kyi sgra mi grags pa'i sa rnams su/ tshogs pa 'bum phrag 'du ba'i dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs/ thar pa gling du ming btags/ slob dpon dpal mchog gi gcung po/ slob dpon sangs rgyas kun dga' zhes bya ba bla mar bskos/ thams cad dam pa'i chos rdzogs pa chen po'i lta sgom la bkod do/ /mngon par rdzogs sangs rgyas kyang bshes gnyen mchog tu bsten/ /spangs rtogs phun sum tshogs kyang sems can don la brtson/ /rang don chos sku brnyes kyang gzhan don gzugs sku'i mdzod/ / sngon med nam mkha'i nor bu de ni gtsug gis mchod/ / de nas lho brag dang*/ yar 'brog pa la sogs pa'i gdan 'dren byung nas/ nan gyis zhus pas/ mkhan chen dge 'dun rgyal mtshan gyi zhabs su dge 'dun lnga brgya 'du ba dang*/ bla ma spus gong pa la dge 'dun sum brgya lhag 'dus pa rnams la 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i khrid bstan nas sma ི na grol la bkod do/ / de nas khri dpon rdo rje rgyal mtshan pas gdan drangs nas yar 'brog tu chos gsung dus/

dbu stod nas bla ma o rgyan pa dang*/ rgyas sras bzod pa dge slong gzhon nu bkra shis la sogs pa rnams mjal du byon/ dbus su 'byon pa'i zhu ba byas/ khong rnams tshur 'byon khar/ rgyal sras bzod pa la/ do dgongs nga'i phya ther 'og tu shog /do nub lhan du sdod pa yin gsung*/ der byon pas gsol ja ba chos dpal rgyal mtshan la/ nged dpon slob la zas sna bzang po gyis la drongs/ ja bzang po zhig kyang bkol gsung nas dgyes tshor chen po mdzad/ dbus pa rnams 'gro chug /su la yang ma smra/ khri dpon rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis mkha' 'gro snying tig gi zhu ba byas pas bshad par byas nas yod/ khyod mkha' 'gro snying thig 'tshol ba la kong por chos rgyal rin chen gling pa'i rtsar 'gro ba yin zer zhing 'dug pa/ de ltar gyis byas nas btang ba yin/ kong po na rin chen gling pa dang*/ dwags po byar na gter ston gyi dngos slob sprul sku legs ldan pa gnyis la/ mkha' 'gro snying thig zhus nas 'dug pa legs / da gdod rgyud dag ma dag gi gtam mi yong ba yin/ don dam par chos 'di'i bdag po nga yin/ nyams snang dang rmi lam la chos 'di'i bdag po khyod yin gsung ba dang*/ dngos su chos bdag gi mkha' 'gro rnams kyis mngon sum du nga la gtad pa yin/ khyod rang rings rgyu med na sdod la chos 'di nyon/ phog ni nang nas ster/ glu gang mkhas bro rar bcug na gsal bya ba yin pas/ khong gnyis dang gang mkhas yid ches skye ba yin gsung*/ rgyal sras rin po ches bla ma o rgyan pa la mkha' 'gro snying thig gsung pa 'dra bas khyed rang bzhugs na 'thad gsung pas/ khong na re/ bi ma snying thig tshar mang zhig thob/ mkha' 'gro snying thig la yang de las lhag pa med las che nged 'gro ba yin gsung*/ 'o na de ltar mdzod byas khong rnams bzhud/ 'brog khri dpon pas gtsor mdzad dpon g.yog bcu gsum dge slong dpal 'byor bla ma dang dpon slob yongs dril dpon g.yog bco lnga la mkha' 'gro snying thig gi khrid gsung*/

gter nas byon 'phral mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs thu le ba'i chos yin pas dam dogs che bar mdzod/ kun tu bzang po sangs rgyas mi gzugs can/ /chos mchog zab gter mkha' 'gro snying thig ste/ /sras kyi thu bo rgyal sras bzod pa la/ /thugs kyi dkyil du dgongs pas dgyes par gnang*/ /bsnyel ba mi mnga' thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ khyed kyi rjes 'jug rnams la thar pa'i lam/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas lag tu gtod mdzad pa'i/ /bshes gnyer dam pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas g.yor po gzhung du gdan drangs pa la sngar dgrar 'dzin cing yod na'ang*/ mdzad pa dang 'dra ba la dad par gyur nas tā'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis sngon la ja 'dren/ rting la ja sig gcig /nas khal lnga bcu/ de'i sha mar thud rnams phog btab/ na bza' cha tshang gcig 'bul bar byas/ de nas snyan pa dang grags pa dang gdul bya che zhing*/ 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i yon tan la dad da ེ/ sangs rgyas dpal rin gyis dpon slob kyi mtshams sbyar/ gong dkar du phyags phebs/ si tu bas gtso mdzad rnams la o rgyan drag po'i dbang dang byin rlabs gnang bas mos pa thob ste/ rje gshegs pa'i rjes su 'ang gdung 'bul gyis mnyes par byas pa'o/ /de nas khrid btsugs te stong phrag yod zer ba'i tshogs pa 'dus/ dbu stod nas kyang bla ma dam pa rgyal sras bzod pa dang*/ dge slong grags pa dpal gyis thog drangs chos nyan mang rabs chos gsan du byon/ tshogs pa ches pas chos nyan la phyag dam 'gyed dgos pa byung*/ der tshogs pa rnams smin grol gyi lam la bkod/ de'i dus su chos rje bla ma rgyal mtshan dam pa'i drung nas/ 'phan yul ba'i slob ma thun mong ba zhig la/ bla ma dam pas rdzogs pa chen po'i gzhi lam 'bras bu'i bzhed tshul ci 'dra ba yin zhus pa las/ gzhi lam 'bras bu'i bzhed tshul tshig nyung la don 'gra ི la ba zhig rin po che gser gyi mchod sdong zhes bya ba tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis phul ba'i rgyab yig las/

rab gsal snyan par smra ba'i ngag 'di ni/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i gnas la ma rmongs shing*/ /lung rig man ngag du ma'i blo mig can/ /snying po'i de nyid rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ / gzhung ri rin chen brtsegs pa'i gnas nas phul/ / ces pa'i zhu yig phyag tu phul bas/ chos rje bsod rgyal ba bsam yas su bzhugs pas/ chos rje dor du phyag thegs pa'i shul/ gzims chung gi glo phug tu lus nas 'dug pa bsam yas gyi dkor gnyer des/ rdzogs chen pa'i sgom chen cig la khyed kyi bla ma rdzogs chen pa'i gsung sgros zhig /chos rje bsod rgyal ba phyag thegs pa'i gzims chung du lus nas 'dug zer bas/ de nga la e ster byas pas chog zer nas byin/ do red sa rtsa smag dus sgo drag po brdung zhing 'dug pa bltas pas/ dkor gnyer des sbyin pas chog le ma red/ gsung shog mdzad nas nye gnas len du btang 'dug pa la da lta rang skur gsung*/ skyil smad pa'i zul phu ba ston grags kyis khrid gzhi la nas khal sum brgya phul/ skyor mo lung pa des nas khal nyis brgya 'bul zer ba dang*/ gzhan yang brgya 'bul ba kha yar byung*/ de dus dbus stod nas ta'i si tu shākya bzang pos thog drangs/ slob ma rnams kyis gdan 'dren yang byung*/ skabs shig la zhu nan ches pas 'byon par mdzad/ phyag 'jog khar rang du gzhung nas kun mkhyen pa'i slob ma sngar mtshan nyid po ti 'ga' yar shes pa gcig gis drung du nga rang mjal nas chos zhu ba mang tshad yod na'ang*/ lo bdun du mtshams kyi dam bcas byas yod pas yong ba'i thabs ma byung*/ chos kyi dri ba 'di rnams kyi lan gsal po thugs la 'dogs par zhu zer nas/ zhu yig dang 'bul ba byung nas/ nyin par ni chos dang mjal mkhan gyis brel bas thugs ma skabs/ nub mo bla ma dam pa bzod pas/ phyag bris mdzad nas/ dris len don gyi rab 'byed ces bya ba bskur/ de nas byon pas lam du zhabs tog pa mang bas zhag sbrel 'gor/

tshu ri pha ri rnams bsu ba ni tsho 'khrugs/ tshur ri'i gtsang 'gram na chos khri brtsegs nas gsang phu gling stod pa'i slob dpon ye rgyal gyis thab khyogs nas ja gsol ba'i ring la/ chos kyi dri ba tshig re zhus pa la mda' tshad mang rab re'i lan gsung*/ de nas chos kyi dri ba zhu ba'i spobs pa med par gsang phu ba la nged rang 'dra ba gzhan med pas/ skyong bran thugs la 'dogs par zhus/ yang dgos su nged rang gling stod pa nyams nas yod zhus pas/ khong la ja bzang po gdum gcig

/srab cham gcig /gser srang bcu/ gling stod pa spyi la ja sig lnga/ klad yol chen mo gcig /ther ras phrug gsum/ dgu tshan gcig gnang*/ /e ma tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i 'bras bu dus 'dir smin/ /nam mkha' mdzod la mnga' brnyes phrin las can/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhis sems can tshim mdzad cing*/ re ba skong mdzad de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas yar mo che ba'i jo gdan rnams kyis rol cha dang bcas lbu ba gdong nas bsu ba byas/ ra mo cher phebs ja zhu zhing yod pa'i skabs su/ rme ru ba'i jo gdan rnams mjal ba dang*/ ser sbrengs la byung ba la mjal kha ma byung*/ zla ba phyed ni lha sar bzhugs pa lha sa dang*/ ra sa gnyis kyi bar du khri mthon po brtsigs te thugs bskyed gsungs pas/ sa phyogs de chos nyan gyis gang*/ gsang mtshur sde gsum gyi dge gshes nga rgyal can mang pos chos nyan sar ltad mo bltas pas/ las rgyu 'bras kyi chos bshad mdzad pa'i rting na/ khong rnams dad pa skyes nas/ 'di 'dra zhig yin pa zer zhing phyag btsal te chos nyan gyi gral la 'khor/ /chos tshar nas ra mo cher 'byon zhing yod pa la/ /si tu shākya bzang pos zhu yig dang gdan 'dren/ gzhan yang bla ma dpon skya mang tshad cig gis sleb nas byung*/ yar 'byon par zhal gyis bzhes/ de nas snying thig gi khrid gsungs pa la/ snye phu shug gseb tu byon/ khrid nyan stong phrag tshogs pas khrid zhu tsho 'di tsam mang 'dug pas/ khrid gzhis mi lcogs par 'dug cing khrid gzhi rgyu khrid gnyer ba la 'bul bar zhu zhus pas/ chos nyan rnams kyis mi lcogs na khas mi len pa yin zer ba la/ chos rje'i drung du khrid gzhi'i nas mang po phul bas mnyes pa che ba e yin/ nga gar 'gro mkha' 'gro chos skyaung gis bya ba sgrub cing yod pas/ tshogs 'khor la mi thogs gsungs nas/ phyag dam bkye nas chos gsung*/ dge slong dpon grags pas dbu stod du yar 'gro ba'i zhu ba byas bas/

de bzhin mdzad gsung*/ nga'i rta btsong nas med pas lha sa bar du chibs pa zhig g.yar po zhu zhus pas/ rta med na khyed gar thon rta khyer bas chog gsung*/ nang par tsha ba gnang nas/ chibs pa rngam pa sgra sgrogs btang*/ rta bsgyur ba la rtogs ldan gyad thung zer ba btang*/ lam ring thung gnyis yod pa'i thung ba de sa gzar bas ring ba de skor gsungs/ phyag dbang zhus shing yod kyang ldabs nas gsungs/ zhal ta'i lugs bzhin rtogs ldan gyis byed byas pas/ thugs kyis gzigs cha yin/ ngas mi tshe rta la bskyal bas a'u tsi nye sa nas 'gro byas pas/ rtas brdabs rtsib ma gnyis bcags/ rtogs ldan rta bzlog nas 'gro dus/ rtas brdabs pa ma zhu bka' bkyon thugs khrel yong zer nas/ ngag bsdams shugs gseb tu slebs dus chibs rta ka ba la btad/ drung du phyag 'tshal ba la song bas/ ngan pa rnams byas pa la mi nyan de e ma byung gsung*/ dge slong dpon grags par ra mo cher sman dpyad rim gro chen po dgos pa byung*/ des na thogs pa med pa'i mngon par shes pa yod par yid ches so/ /mi yi khyu mchog chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /smra ba'i zla ba mngon shes spyan dang ldan/ /'phags pa'i gang zag 'di 'dra gzhan su zhig /dus gsum rnam mkhyen de la gus phyag 'tshal/ / de nas dbu stod du byon nas/ si tus mkhar ba rir gdan drangs/ zhag gsum du bzhugs dbyar gnas kyi phogs btab nas/ yar o rgyan du byon tshogs pa rgya mtsho lta bu 'tshogs/ o rgyan gyi rdza 'dabs man chad/ pha ri'i brag rtsa de yan chad/ phya ther dkar nag khra gsum gyis bkang*/ chos nyan rnyed pa las sum log gis mang*/ gsar pa'i chos nyan gyi drag pa dus 'khor ba dge 'dun dpal gyis thog drangs/ chos 'chad pa'i bla ma slob dpon yang bzhi bcu la slebs tsam 'dug /'bri gung ba'i khul gyi bla ma slob dpon/ dpon skya mang po 'tshogs pa la/ 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i khrid zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin par btsugs nas/

tshes brgyad gcig la 'tshogs pa la 'gyed chen gcig mdzad/ zla ba byung ngo cog gi tshes bcu la 'phan yul yan chad rtse mo rgyal man chod tshogs pa rgya mtsho lta bu la tshes bcu'i mchod pa gya noms pa mdzad sngar snying thig gi khrid zhu ba'i dus chos khral la ma thogs pas da gzod nga la chos bshad pa'i dus byung na/ chos khral la bcad thang mi byed pa dang*/ dad rdzas phyag tu ci byung ba'i sum gnyis tshes bcu dang tshes brgyad la btang zhing sum cha gcig gis 'phral dgos 'tsho ba dang*/ bu slob gzigs skyong mdzad pa'i dam bca' brtan po mdzad/ dad zas chud mi gson pa'i ched du/ tshes bcu dang*/ tshes brgyad kyi zan yang sings po dang dar bas brdzi zhing*/ spyan lam du 'byung ba'i bza' btung dngos po mchod pa gnyis la dmigs sgom byas pa la/ che btsun gal po cher byas pa su byung yang*/ 'di zos pas mi 'ju gsung nas mi gnang*/ 'gyed mdzad dus gral mtho ba rnams kyi skal pa chad dogs med gsungs nas/ /gral gzhug nas yar la 'gyed/ bkur sti dge 'dun la dgos pa yin/ sdig can rnams la mi dgos gsung nas skye nag la mi gnang*/ chen por 'dod pa rnams la gdan mi 'ding*/ bkur sti mi mdzad pa ni thugs kyi dam bca' yin/ 'byor ldan phyug po rnams kyi tshogs gsog dang 'bul ba ci tsam byas kyang*/ chos dad gus kyi sgo nas sgrub pa yin phyag byed bzang*/ thugs la btags zhal du mi 'don/ brdab lan dang gnang sbyin mi mdzad/ byas na tshong du 'gro bas khong rang gi dngos po de chud zos yin/ shākya thub pa la ras yug gser srang stong ri ba phul yang*/ bsngo ba mdzad pa ma gtogs pa gnang sbyin mdzad pa'i srol med/ tshogs bsags dang chos 'don la sogs pa yon bdag gis bya rgyu yin/ yon mchod go log na nan ltar mi bzang gsung*/ 'dul ba lung la sogs gtam rgyud lung 'dren mang bar mdzad/ sprang po la sogs pa nyam chung gis skyo ra nag po gcig drangs na yang zhim zhim ltar gsol/

mdo bsngo dang yon bshad rgyas pa re mdzad/ tshogs gnyis mkha' la sgṛb gnyis chu 'dzin bral/ /mkhyen pa'i nyi gzhon 'od stong lhag ge bas/ /skal ldan rnams kyi 'dab stong rgyas pa dang*/ / mnyam du skye dgu'i rkang drug tshim mdzad bstod/ / de nas tshogs pa la dbang khrid shin tu rgyas par mdzad nas/ rgyab chos gsung pa'i nyin gcig gi skabs na/ rgyal sras bzod pas spos phor dang bcas nang du gdan drangs pa'i tshe yang*/ khyod la brel ba med na/ mkha' 'gro snying thig gi dras kha'i shog bu 'ga' dros gsung tshar ba dang skas de phar bsgyur la su yang ma btang bar snyug gu tshugs gsung nas/ zhal chems dri ma med pa'i 'od sprad pa'i skabs su/ da ni mi sdod pad+ma las 'brel rtsal/ /'chi med bde chen btsan sa 'dzin du 'gro/ /tshe zad las zad smon lam 'phen pa zad/ gsung pa'i skabs su rgyal sras bzod pa spyan chab kyis brnang bzhin du/ phyag btsal nas gsol ba btab cing rten 'brel ngan pa 'di 'dra ba mi gsung bar zhu zhus pas/ rten 'brel ngan rgyu ci yod/ da lta dal ba'i dus su byas pas da gzod brel ba'i dus su phan pa yin gsung nas/ bu slob spyi la zhal chems dri ma med pa 'di dang sgos su snying thig pa rnams la zhal chems gnad kyi me long gnyis mdzad nas/ mkha' 'gro snying thig gi po ti'i nang du bcugs/ 'di 'dra byas su la yang ma smra gsungs so/ /gshegs par dgongs nas sras kyi thu bo la/ /zhal chems bzhag nas mngon shes yod par bstan/ /mthong spangs ma rig tshogs las dben pa yin/ /'jam dbyangs dngos su bstan la gus pas bstod/ / de nas chos nyan 'brel ba yod pa rnams so sor gyes bla ma slob dpon rnams dang chos nyan grwa pa rnams kyis dbang gong ma la sogs pa'i zhu ba byas pas/ 'di gu ru jo 'ber gyis kyang ma gnang ba'i chos yin mi 'ong gsung*/ nan gyis zhus pas/ 'o na khrid gnyer ngan pa de rnams kyis spyang ki byed par yod 'dug

khrid gnyer ba brjes gsung nas/ dbang zhu ba rnams la dmigs pa phog nas ri la btang ste/ rim pa bzhi du dbang mdzad/ rgyud bcu bdun/ tha ེ ga mchog rin po che'i mdzod/ yang tig yid bzhin nor bu dang bcas pa rdzogs par gsung chos thon pa'i tshogs 'khor gyi nang par rang re dpon slob zab mo'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas/ tshogs kyi dga' ston byed pa yang da nang tsam du gda' 'o/ khyed rang gzhan don nus pa rnams kyis skal ba dang ldan pa'i slob ma gang byung la rang 'dod kyi 'khris med par dbang bskur/ rgyud shod / man ngag ston/ dam chos nyams su len pa rnams 'jeg rten gyi bya ba don du ma gnyer bar/ khregs chod dang thod rgal gyi don la mnyam par zhog /ma go ba'i skabs byung na kho bos byas pa'i yang thig yid bzhin nor bu 'di/ nor bu bsam 'phel dang 'dra ba yin pas blta rtog zhib mo gyis la sgoms dang*/ 'khor ba zad sar bskyal nas myang 'das kyi sa la slebs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes legs par gdams so/ / gnam g.yogs bral ba'i mkhal la mtha' dbus med/ /lta sgom rdzogs la srid zhi mnyam pa nyid/ /zad sar bskyal bas kun bzang dgongs pa rdzogs/ /chos rje klong chen rab 'byams dad brgyas mchod/ /de nas zhwa'i lha khang gi gtsug lag khang gi nyam gsos rnams mdzad pa dang*/ mchod pa 'bul ba la 'byon pa'i skabs su/ chos skyong la gsol ka mdzad khrom la chos gsungs pa'i tshe me tog gi char rtsod pa med par babs/ thams cad la thar pa'i sa bon thebs par mdzad/ chu bo rir phyags phebs pa dang*/ o rgyan du byon nas/ rten 'brel rnams 'chug yon bdag rnams la yang mi 'thad pa 'ga' re byung bar 'dug kho bos khyed rnams la mya ngan mi 'jog gsung*/ de nas bsam yas pa'i dud gtong drug gi gdan 'dren byung bas/ rgya mar zhag shas gcig bzhugs nas la la byon pa'i tho rangs 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan pa la sogs pa bla ma slob dpon/

yon bdag bu slob dang bcas pas skyes thung byas nas/ rgya ma yun thang du phyag phebs pas chibs las gzhos nas/ sa 'ja' li'i steng na bzhugs te/ da khyed rang rnams phyir log 'phreng ba las mi yong*/ khyed rnams kyis kyang da nang nas nga mthong ba min/ khyed rang rnams chos la 'bungs/ nged dum pa zhig 'dir 'dug gsung pas/ thams cad kyi gdong mchi mas khebs te so sor gyes/ de nas la la byon nas mchims phur phyags phebs pa'i nyin par/ 'o rgya gar gyi dur khrod bsil ba tshal gyi dod po yin pas/ gzhan du skyes pa bas 'dir shi bar dga' bar bshad/ nga'i sgyu lus kyi phung po 'di yang mchims phu'i dur khrod chen po 'dir 'jog /bsam pa gcig kyang thog tu phebs pa yin gsung dud gtong drug gis thog drangs pa'i phyogs nas 'dus pa'i tshogs pa rnams la khrid btab/ tshogs pa ches pas spros med kyi dbang la zhag grangs mang rabs shig song ba'i skabs su/ bsnyungs pa'i tshul bstan yang nub re bzhin dbang mdzad/ bcu drug gi nyin par mchod gtor shom dbang byed gsung pas/ sku bsnyungs pas 'o brgyal zhag gsum sku ngal gso bar mdzad par zhus pas/ de mi dgos dbang 'di tshar ba zhig byed gsung pa la nan gyis zhus pas dbang 'di tshar ba zhig byed bsam pa yin te/ khyed rnams mi nyan par 'dug gsung nas steng du bzhud/ de nas chu mo yos kyi lo lnga bcu rtsa drug bzhes pa la rgyal gyi zla ba'i tshes bco brgyad kyi dro khar song ba dang/ gu ru pa dang*/ slob dpon kun dpal la sogs pa 'ga' zhig drung du yod pa la mchod pa gcig shom la khyed rang rnams mdor song gsung*/ de rnams mi 'gro 'dir 'dug par zhu zhus pas/ 'o na sgyu lus gog pa 'di 'dor ba yin pas/ khyed rang rnams zhed mi dgos/ ca co ma byed par mnyam gzhag la sdod gsungs nas chos sku'i bzhugs stangs kyis gdod ma'i zad sar gshegs so/ /kye ma kye hud skyabs gnas thugs rje can/

/rgya mtsho'i gos can 'di dag dang mtshungs su/ /da ni mi bzhugs gdod ma'i sar gshegs pa/ /bdag cag skal ba ldan rnams 'dor phod dam/ /bshes bral dmul long thang chen dbus lhung ltar/ /mgon po khyed min bdag cag su la re/ / byang chub ljon shing rkang 'thung chag gyur pas/ /sdug bsngal tshad pas gdungs la bsil byed su/ / dpal ldan yon tan dpag med 'byung ba'i gnas/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i 'brog dgon der gshegs pas/ /lhar bcas rnams kyi gtsug rgyan rin po che/ /yengs ma skabs la stor zhing mgon med gyur/ /smra ba'i seng ge skyes mchog chen pos kyang*/ /bas mtha'i nags su ded dpon stor ba ltar/ /de ring bdag snying mya ngan chen pos gdungs/ /da ni dbyings nas thugs rjes gzigs 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ni smre sdags kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de nas rgyal gyi zla ba dang*/ cho 'phrul gyi ring la nyin mtshan med par 'ja'i gur phub/ me tog gi sil ma bkram/ 'khyags pa rnams rang zhu / se ba'i dung lo rgyas/ der tshogs pa'i skal ldan 'ga' zhig la/ 'od gsal gyi snang bas phyam brdal bar gyur/ zhag nyi shu lnga'i bar sku gdung bzhugs pa la/ tsan+dan dang*/ ga pur gyi dri zil gyis non pa'i dri ngad bzang pos khyab par gyur/ zhal ta la gdung khang gsar pa ma brtsig par/ rnying ba zhig tu khyer la bzhugs gsung pas/ mchod pa'i sprin phung mang po dang bcas nas gdung khang rnying pa zhig tu gdan drangs pa'i tshe/ sa chen po 'di rab tu g.yos shing*/ 'ur 'ur chem chem pa'i sgra lan bdun du grags par gyur to/ / thub ba'i dbang po ku sha'i tshal gzigs tshe/ /nyan thos rnams kyang mya ngan gyis gdungs ltar/ /dri med 'od zer mchims phur gzigs pa'i tshe/ / mthong thos rnams kyang mya ngan zug rngu sa gzir/ /mkha' klong yangs pa'i dbyings kyang ma rdibs la/ /'byung ba 'dzin ma 'di yang ma chag na/ /chu gter chen po 'khrugs par ma gyur cing*/

/bdag cag rnams la 'di ltar gyur 'di ci/ / de nas bzhus pa'i tshe/ thugs ljags spyan gsum gdung khang nas 'phar te/ skal ba dang ldan ba'i pang du byon pa dang*/ rigs lnga'i rang bzhin thob pa'i rtags su/ sha rī raṃ la sogs pa gdung rigs lnga dang ring bsrel/ phra mo grangs las 'das shing 'phel gdung du gyur nas/ re re la yang brgya phrag 'phel zhing da lta'i bar du/ 'phel ba kun gyis mthong zhing rtsod pa med do/ /'di ni chos kyi sku las gzugs kyi skur bzhengs te/ gdul bya'i khams dang mos pa ji lta ba bzhin du 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la spobs pa thogs pa med par 'jug ste/ de la sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa dam pa'i chos rgyu dang 'bras bu'i theg pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dag las/ dam pa rnams kyi bka' drin la brten nas kho bo cag gi khong du chud pa'i don phyir bstan bcos su bkod pa la/ phyi'i gnas dang nang gi gnas dang de kho na nyid kyi gnas gsum du rnam par bzhag pa la/ dang po ni gsung rab la 'jug pa'i them skas sam thun mong du gyur pa dag gi phyogs su gtogs pa'i bstan bcos la/ yi ge'i sdeb sbyor la 'jug pa rin chen snye ma che 1chung 2gnyis/ rig pa klog pa'i don bsdus/3 sgra bzhi'i mtshams sbyor/4 klog gi bstan bcos zla ba gsal byed/5 sdeb sbyor la 'jug pa nyi ma'i shing rta/6 lci yang gi gnas pa rin po che'i sde mig7 mngon brjod la 'jug pa me tog gi 'khri shing*/8 snyan ngag gi bstan bcos me tog rgyas pa'i skyed mos tshal/9 dper brjod kyi gnas nges pa klu shing gi me tog10 /spel ma'i gnas la 'jug pa tshangs pa'i gsung dbyangs te/11 gtso bo lus lta bu'i bstan bcos rnam par dbye ba dang*/ thams cad spel mar ston pa 'phros pa yan lag gi bstan bcos la/ mi'am ci kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar/12 gzhon nu zhi ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa me tog gi chun po/13

blo gsal ri bong gi rtogs brjod/14 legs par gdams pa lha'i rnga bo che lta bu'i gtam/15 po ta la kun tu dga' ba'i gtam/16 legs par sbyar ba'i snyan ngag zla ba'i 'khri shing rab tu bzang po/17 me tog gi ra ba/18 nags kyi gtam pad+ma dkar po/19 nags kyi gtam gangs ri'i rgyan/20 nags kyi gtam kun tu bzang po/21 nags kyi gtam ku mu da'i 'khri shing*/ 22 nags tshal kun tu dga' ba'i gtam/23 chos kyi sdom bzhi dri ma med pa'i gtam/24 chos bzhi rin po che'i phreng ba/25 slob dpon brtag pa'i rab tu byed pa/26 rab byung brtag pa'i rab tu byed pa/27 skye ba brtags pa'i rab tu byed pa/28 mkhas blun brtag pa'i rab tu byed pa/29 bshes gnyen brtag pa'i rab tu byed pa/30 chos dang chos min brtag pa'i rab tu byed pa/31 shin tu bya dka' ba'i gnas kyi dper brjod yi ger bkod pa/32 dbyangs nges pa can gyi rgyan/33 dus la mngon par skyo ba'i rabs/34 rang la gros su btab pa'i rabs/35 thar pa la bskul ba'i rabs/36 bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs rje la bskul ba'i rabs/37 phyogs kyi sde snod 'dzin pa rnams la gtam du bya ba'i rabs/38 bla ma dam pa la zhu ba zhu yig rin chen gser gyi mchod sdong*/39 zhu yig pad+ma stong ldan/40 zhu yig nor bu'i dra ba/41 zhu yig rma bya'i nga ro/42 phyogs kyi slob ma la bsngags pa lha'i rnga sgra/43 sbyin bdag la bsngags pa rin po che

'i bang mdzod/44 dri ba nyi shu pa'i lan rgya cher bshad pa/45 sems dang ye shes kyi dri ba'i lan rgya cher bshad pa/46 mkhas grub dam pa rnams kyi myang 'das che chung*/47 bstan pa snyigs ma'i skyo ba bsam pa/48 rgyu la khams 'dus pa me tog phreng ldan/49 rkyen la khams 'dus pa ka kha sum cu/50 gnyis ka la khams 'dus pa dran pa'i me long*/51 skye bo dga' ba skyed pa glu gar gyi rtsed mo/52 byis pa bzhad gad slong ba spre'u'i zlos gar/53 'jig rten lugs la 'jug pa mdzangs kyi 'phrul yig54 /bde bar gshegs pa la bstod pa rnga bo che'i dbyangs snyan/55 yum la bstod pa yid bzhin nor bu/56 yon tan tshad med par bstod pa/57 bsam gyis mi khyab par bstod pa/58 dpe las 'das par bstod pa/59 spyan ras gzigs la bstod pa lha'i sil snyan/60 rta mgrin la bstod pa glog gi phreng ba/61 'jam dpal dkar po la bstod pa mu tig gi phreng ba/62 dmar po la bstod pa mi'am ci'i dbyangs snyan/63 ser po la bstod pa dri za'i rgyud mangs/64 sngon po la bstod pa sprin gyi nga ro/65 'phags ma dbyangs can ma la bstod pa gzhon nu mchog dga'i dbyangs ku mu ta'i phreng ba pad+ma'i dra ba/66 'phags ma nor rgyun ma la bstod pa gser gyi sprin phung*/67 ku ru kul+le la bstod pa dbang po'i rgyud mangs/68 dug sel ma la bstod pa klu'i gtsug rgyan/69 'od zer can la bstod pa 'jigs pa kun sel/70 dpal mo la bstod pa dbang po'i me tog71 /phag mo dkar mo la bstod pa dpal gyi phreng 'dzin/72 dmar mo la bstod pa dus kyi phreng ba/73 nag mo la bstod pa dngos grub kun 'byung*/74 mi g.yo dkar po la bstod pa mal+li ka'i phreng ba/75 dmar po la bstod pa dus mtshams kyi sprin/76 sngon po la bstod pa 'byung po kun 'dul/77 sgrol ma la bstod pa dpyid kyi nga ro/78 tshogs bdag la bstod pa nor bu'i bang mdzod/79

dbang phyug la bstod pa lha'i me tog80 khyab 'jug la bstod pa klu'i nga ro/81 dbu ma la bstod pa ku mu ta'i gnyen/82 tshangs pa la bstod pa rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs/83 dus kyi lha la bstod pa dpyid kyi thig le/84 ri dang rgya mtsho la bstod pa phyogs kyi nga ro/85 mchims phu'i gnas la bstod pa dus bzhi'i me tog86 /yer ba'i gnas la bstod pa pad+ma'i phreng ba/87 gangs ri thod dkar gyi gnas la bstod pa rol mo'i dbyangs snyan/88 lum pa'i gtsug lag la bstod pa rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs/89 bsam yas kyi yul gyi bkod pa gsal bar byed pa gangs ri'i rgyan/90 gsang phu'i chos grwa la bsngags pa yon tan phreng tshogs/91 zhwa pad+ma dbang chen gyi gtsug lag khang la bstod pa rol mo'i sprin phung*/92 dkar chag rgyas par rtsis kyi yig ge zhib mo/ 93 bsdus pa ngo mtshar dran byed/ 94 gsol 'debs dad rgyan gyi me tog 95la sogs phra mo'i gnas dpag tu med pa zhig skye bo chos la 'jug pa'i ched du sbyar ba yin no/ /snyan ngag mtsho chen sdeb sbyor pad+ma'i tshal/ /mngon brjod ge sar 'dab stong rab rgyas te/ tshig don rnam bkra'i rang bzhin bkod legs pa/ blo gsal rkang drug ldan rnams dga' bar mdzod/ 'di rnams phyi'i gnas dang mthun pa'i bstan bcos kyi dkar chag ste dang po'o// //de nas nang gi gnas rgya cher bshad pa la/ rgyu mtshan nyid dang 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa gnyis las/ re zhig mtshan nyid theg pa'i phyogs su gtogs pa'i bstan bcos la/ byams pa'i chos lnga'i spyi'i don 'grel du sa lam gyi rnam par bzhag pa rin chen them skas rtsa 96'grel 97dang bcas pa/ mngon rtogs rgyan gyi lus rnam bzhag gsal byed rgyan gyi snang ba/98 'dul ba ka ri ka'i gsal byed 'od kyi snye ma/99 rang rgyud shar gsum gyi don bsdus de kho na nyid la 'jug pa/100 dbu ma thal 'gyur gyi gnas gsal ba rab tu mi gnas pa'i don bsdus/101

bde ba gnyis rab tu bya ba la 'jug pa/102 de'i man ngag lam rim gsal ba/103 sems spyod don gyi snying po/104 lung sbyor rin po che'i phreng ba/105 sems bskyed rin po che gser gyi me tog106 /bslab bya rgyal sras lam bzang*/107 zab mo mdo lnga'i don bshad/108 smon lam rgya mtsho'i snying po/109 gcod yul dag pa'i lam khyer/110 phung po gsum pa'i nyams len/111 'da' ka ye shes kyi sgom thabs la sogs pa/112 byang chub sems dpa' ི spyod pa mdo dang mthun pa'i gnas du ma rgyu 'bras zab mo'i lam la brten nas thar pa 'dod pa dag gi don du legs par bkod pa yin no/ / zab cing rgya che'i gsung rab gangs chen mtsho/ / rgyal ba rgyas sras gdengs can dbang po'i gnas/ yon tan yid bzhin 'byung gnas phyogs gsal bas/ /dad ldan thar pa 'dod rnams dga' bar mdzod/ / don gnyis pa gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i phyogs su gtogs pa'i bstan bcos la/ rgyud sde bzhi'i gnas zab cing rgya che bar bstan pa las/ bshad pa'i gnas gsal bar bstan pa yid bzhin rin po che'i mdzod rtsa ba/113 'grel pa pad+ma dkar po dang bcas pa/114 sgyu 'phrul dra ba chen po'i chos kyi rnam grangs las/ gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid du nges pa'i spyi don yid kyi gsang 'grel phyogs bcu mun sel yin nam/ mun sel/115 bsdus don ma rig mun sel/116 rigs lnga ye shes snang ba rnams dang*/ 117 chos spyod thams cad kyi mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyud kyi bshad 'grel byang chub ljon shing*/118 rgyud sde bzhi'i spyi don bshad pa rdo rje 'byung ba/119 dam tshig gsum bkod kyi rnam bshad nyi ma'i 'od zer/120 phrin sgrub cho ga'i skor la/ sgyu 'phrul zhi khro'i skongs bshags kyi cho ga rgyas pa/121 de'i le'u lag bsdus pa/122 bla ma'i phrin sgrub rin po che'i sgron me/123 thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dong sprug gi cho ga pad+ma cod pan/124

kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor du slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur ba'i cho ga125 /rdo rje slob dpon gyi las rim rgyas pa/126 slob ma'i las rim bsdus pa/127 rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga kun tu bzang po/128 cha gsum rgyas pa 'od kyi snye ma/129 bsdus pa rin chen snying po/130 sreg sbyong don rab gsal ba/131 thig rtsa 'od kyi phreng ba/132 sgrol ma' ི maṇ+ḍal bzhi pa'i cho ga bde legs kun 'byung*/133 khri mon las thar pa'i cho ga yid bzhin nor bu/134 'jigs pa brgyad skyob kyi cho ga pad+ma'i dra ba/135 'phags ma dug sel gyi cho ga bdud rtsi'i ljon shing*/136 'phags ma dbyangs can ma'i khrus kyi cho ga rin chen nor bu/137 rnam par rgyal ba'i cho ga yid bzhin phreng ba/138 sman bla'i cho ga yon tan phreng tshogs/139 gnas brtan bcu drug gi cho ga gzhan phan nor bu/140 kha 'bar ma'i gtor chen bar chad kun sel/141 khro bo bcu'i srung bzlog gi cho ga gnas lugs 'khor lo/142 gtsug tor cho ga bgegs dpung zhi byed/143 dregs pa spyi'i bskang gso dngos grub kun 'byung*/144 spyi gsol chen mo/145 phud rabs rgyas pa/146 rngan yig chen mo/147 bye brag ma mo'i bskang gso khrag mtsho khol ma/148 gza' yi bskang gso dgra las rnam rgyal/149 gnod sbyin dmar nag gi bskang gso ri rab brtsegs pa/150 dam can gyi bskang gso las bzhi lhun grub/151 ma mgon spyi'i bskang gso yid bzhin lhun grub rnams dang*/152 bskyed rim gtso bor bton pa sgrub thabs kyi skor la bla ma'i spyi sgrub dngos grub 'byung gtor/ 153 bye brag ba ི ma la'i sgrub pa dngos grub char 'bebs/154 pad+ma zhi bar sgrub pa rin chen khang brtsegs/155 /pad+ma drag por sgrub pa gnam lcags 'bar ba/156 yi dam zhi khro spyi sgrub yang dag don gyi snying po/157 rta mgrin dregs pa mthar byed/158 phur pa sku gsum 'dus pa/159

bde mchog yid bzhin 'khor lo/160 'jam dpal bdud rtsi 'byung ba rnams dang*/161 mkha' 'gro ma spyi'i sgrub thabs gser gyi drwa ba/162 bye brag gtso bo rkyang par sgrub pa thabs kyi 'khor lo/163 dpa' bo rkyang par sgrub pa shes rab 'khor lo/164 sbrag mar sgrub pa bde chen 'khor lo/165 gsang ba snying gi sgrub pa gnad kyi phreng ba/166 yang gsang thod rgal du sgrub pa srog gi thig pa rnams dang*/167 phra mo'i sgrub pa la tshe sgrub bdud rtsi'i bum pa/168 'chi med dbang po'i phreng ba/169 ngan song ba sbyong ba lha lnga'i sgrub thabs zla ba'i nor bu/170 rnam snang gi sgrub thabs ngan song kun sbyong*/171rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs sgrib pa rnam sel/172 mi 'khrugs pa'i sgrub thabs ngan song rnam sbyong*/ 173 shākya thub pa'i sgrub thabs 'od zer kun 'byung*/174 byams pa'i sgrub thabs pad+ma brtsegs pa/175 'jam dpal dkar po'i sgrub thabs shes rab gsal byed 176smra ba'i seng ge'i sgrub thabs blo'i mun sel/177 a ra pa tsa na dkar po'i sgrub thab shes rab 'khor lo/178 ser po'i sgrubs thabs 'od kyi snang ba/179 mi g.yo dkar po'i sgrub thabs snying gi mun sel/180 phag mo dkar mo'i sgrub thabs 'od gyi snying po/181 /ral gcig ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs dga' ba bskyed pa/182 dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs zla ba 'dod 'jo/183 /dmar mo'i sgrub thabs nyi ma'i 'dod 'jo/184 ku ru kul+le'i sgrub thabs rin po che'i me tog185 /tshogs bdag dmar po'i sgrub thabs nor bu'i bang mdzod/186 rnam thos kyi sgrub thabs rgyal mtshan rtse mo/187 dzam lha ser po'i sgrub thabs gser gyi khang brtsegs/188 nag po'i sgrub thabs 'byor pa rgya mtsho/189 nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs gter gyi bum pa/190 a gu li'i sgrub thabs nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/191 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs zla ba'i 'khor lo/192

lha mo gzungs kyi snye ma'i sgrub thabs dkar mo'i phreng ba/193 dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs 'jig rten gsum snang*/194 khyab 'jug gi sgrub thabs grong khyer sum brtsegs rnams dang*/ 195 gzhan yang dregs pa spyi'i sgrub thabs ri nag spungs pa/196 bye brag ma mgon lcam dral gyi sgrub thabs dus kyi mtshon cha/197 'jigs pa ma mo'i sgrub pa srog gi spu gri/198 drag po gza'i sgrub thabs 'jig rten phung byed/199 shan pa gnod sbyin gyi sgrub thabs ro langs skar mda'/200 skyes bu dam can gyi sgrub thabs ging chen 'bar ba/201 cho 'phrul gnam lcags kyi sgrub pa ltas ngan 'phrul gyi bang mdzod/202 'gal byed khram la 'debs pa rgya mtsho du ru ka'i gtad khram 203la sogs te phrin las rnam bzhis bstan pa yun ring du gnas pa'i las rim sgrub pa 204rnams dang*/ ༈ nges don rdzogs rim mthar thug snying po'i don la sgyu 'phrul rim pa/ yang gsang thig le'i gnad yig bstan pa la/ yang dag byang chub snying po'i rdzogs rim ye shes 'khor lo/205 bde mchog rim pa lnga pa'i zab don snying po'i yang zhun/206 gsang 'dus rim pa lnga pa'i zab don 'od gsal 'khor lo/207 sbyor ba yan lag drug gi bsdus don de nyid 'dus pa/208 lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i rim gnyis 'khor lo/209 chos drug gi snying po yang zhun/210 bsdus pa 'od gsal rnam sbyong*/211 thabs lam zab mo'i don bsdus gsang ba'i de nyid/212 shes rab kyi lam rim sems khrid snying por bstan pa/213 phyag rgya chen po'i lam rim gyi zab don rnal 'byor bzhi'i snying po/214 cig car ba'i zab don thog babs/215 dmar khrid gnyis ka'i cha rkyen sku gsum don khrid nam mkha' skor gsum/216 me long bzhi'i gnas lugs/217 sems kyi rdo rje'i glu/218 snang ba lam khyer 'khor 'das kha sbyor/219 rkyen snang rang grol zab don 'dus pa rnams

dang*/220 gzhan yang zhi byed don gyi snying po/221 gcod yul gnas lugs rang babs la sogs te/222 bod 'dir grags so cog gi zab don rdzogs rim rnams bla ma las thos pa'i don shes rab gsum gyis nges par byas pa rnams las snying po'i yang zhun du bsngags te bkod pa yin no/ /yang zab 'bras bu yid bzhin 'og min gnas/ /thams cad bde chen sku gsum gzhal yas khang*/ /ye shes rnga sgra mdzes pa'i 'od gsal bas/ /skal bzang skye bo'i tshogs rnams dga' bar mdzod/ /legs par sbyar ba bstan bcos kyi dkar chag las nang gi gnas bstan pa ste gnyis pa'o// //༈ de nas de kho na nyid kyi bstan bcos rgya cher bshad pa la/ gsang ba'i gnas mdo spyir bstan pa dang*/ gsang chen bla na med pa'i gnas bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis las/ re zhig gi spyir bstan pa la/ theg pa mtha' dag gi don rdzogs pa chen po'i lam du 'jug pa'i sngon 'gro'i thabs lam 223tsam du shes par bya ba'i phyir kun dang mthun la gong du 'dren pa'i lam 'bras bu dang bcas ston pa'i bstan bcos kyi gnas lugs gsal ba/224 man ngag rin po che'i rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso/225 de'i 'grel pa shing rta chen po/226 /bsdus don nyi ma'i snying po/227 chos 'byung shes rab gsal byed/228 khrid yid 'khor ba dong sprug 229rdzogs pa chen po bsam gtan ngal gso230/ de'i 'grel pa shing rta rnam dag 231bsdus don zla ba'i snying po/232 khrid yig thar gling gsal byed/233 rdzogs pa chen po sgyu ma ngal gso/234 de'i 'grel pa shing rta dri med/235 khrid yid nges don snying po rnams dang*/236 sems sde spyi'i don bshad la byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po'i sems 'grel nyi ma'i 'od zer/237 khrid yig nam mkha' klong gsal/238 man ngag gi don 'grel rang grol skor gsum la rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid rang grol/239 'grel pa chen po 'od kyi 'khor lo/240

khrid yig chos sku rang shar/241 rdzogs pa chen po chos nyid rang grol/ 'grel pa 'od kyi snye ma/243 khrid yig chos sku rang babs/244 rdzogs pa chen po mnyam nyid rang grol/245 'grel pa 'od kyi dra ba/246 khrid yig chos sku lhun grub rnams dang*/247 klong sde spyi'i don bshad la/ klong gsum spyi'i don bshad chings/248 nam mkha' rab 'byams 'grel pa yangs dog med pa'i rgya grol/249 man ngag gi don 'grel chos dbyings rin po che'i mdzod/250 'grel pa chos dbyings gsal ba/251 khrid yig khyab brdal klong yangs 252rnams dang man ngag gi sde spyi don bshad pa la/ sku dang ye shes rgyas pa lhun grub snying po/253 'grel pa mi nub rgyal mtshan/254 mtshan dpe sku gsum lag khrid/255 man ngag gi don 'grel kun 'dus rig pa'i gal mdo/256 kun gsal snying gi don 'grel/257 bar do 'od kyi snye ma 258la sogs pa zab cing rgya che ba'i gnas bstan pa lags so/ /yang zab chos mchog nges don snying po'i mkhar/ /sku dang ye shes nyi ma'i 'od brdal bas/ /bla med bstan pa'i pad tshal rgyas pa dang*/ /mnyam du gdul bya'i bya tshogs dga' bar shog /don gnyis pa gsang chen bla na med pa'i gnas mdo spyi dang bye brag tu bshad pa la/ spyi'i chings rgya cher bstan pa dang*/ bye brag zab don snying po bsdu ba gnyis las/ re zhig gsang chen nges pa theg pa'i rgyal po'i rnam bzhag yo ga'i phyogs kyi don du phabs pa'i gnas gsal byed/ grub mtha' rin po che'i mdzod/259 rgyud bcu bdun man ngag brgya dang bcu dgu'i don 'grel theg mchog rin po che'i mdzod/260 lam khyer gnad kyi don 'grel tshig don rin po che'i mdzod/261 chings nges pa man ngag rin po che gser gyi sgrom bu/262 bye brag zab don snying por bsdu ba la/ khrid kyi yi ge sems sbyong bdun pa/263 sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/264 khyung chen gshog rdzogs/265

man ngag gi lung rdzogs par ston pa bla ma yang thig yid bzhin nor bu chos sde lnga bcu rtsa bzhi pa/266 de las shin tu zab pa'i gnas bsdus pa zab mo yang tig chos tshan sum cu rtsa lnga pa 267rnams ni bla ma snying tig byin rlabs lag khrid kyi skor dang*/ khyad par du smon lam lung bstan dang 'brel pa mkha' 'gro snying thig gi skor la man ngag dus la babs pa/ mkha' 'gro lung bstan gyi babs lugs ngo bo lag khrid du bstan pa/268 dbang khrid gdams pa'i mtshon tshul/269 byin rlabs sems la shar ba nges ngon snying po'i gdams pa270ste gnad gsum chos sde lnga bcu rtsa lngar gtan la phabs pa ni/ mkha' 'gro yang tig gi chos kyi rnam grangs so/ /zhar la chos spyod las rim gsol 'debs drug pa/271 /snying po don gyi mgur/272 rdo rje'i glu sum cu dang bcas pa rnams ni de dag gi cha lag tu bstan pa ste/ shin tu zab pa'i yang zab ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i skor du gtogs pa rnams phyi rabs skal ldan rnams kyi don du bum thang thar pa gling du dkar chag la btab pa gu ru lugs su chos rje rin po che'i sku gsung thugs che ba'i yon tan bstan pa'i phyir rnam par thar pa gsal bar bkod pa yin no// //ngag gi dbang pos 'chad lugs mthong tsa na/ /sku mched gsum po'i chos 'chad dig dig po/ /klong chen rab 'byams rig grwar rtsod tsa na/ /phya gtsang dan gsum rtsod pa rkyang rkyang po/ /kun mkhyen chen po'i rtsom pa mthong tsa na/ /bu dol sher gsum rtsom pa mog mog po/ /sna tshogs rang grol lta dgongs mthong tsa na/ /chen po gsum gyi grub mtha' yu yu po/ /'phan pa bzang po'i mdzad spyod mthong tsa na/ /chen por 'dod pa'i spyod pa dman dman 'dra/ /pad+ma las 'brel yon tan mthong tsa na/ /rtogs ldan ming btags rnams kyang blun blun po/ /gu yangs blo bde'i bya bral mthong tsa na/ / bzang po zhig po'i spyod pa dman dman 'dra/

/dri med 'od zer gzhan don mthong tsa na/ /chen por rlom rnams gzhan don lad mo 'dra/ /zhes pa 'di yang bdag nyid chen po 'di gzhan las ches mchog tu gyur pa'o/ /tshogs gnyis rba rlabs ye shes chu gter can/ /mkhyen rtse'i lbu phreng ri dbang brtsegs ngog rol/ /dbang bzhi'i chu rgyun skye dgu'i dri ma sbyong*/ /bden gnyis dal 'babs de la gus pas bstod/ /thugs rje klu dbang mkhyen brtse'i gdengs kas mdzes/ /nus stobs gru char skye rgu'i zhing sar gshim/ / byams pa'i phud sgra phyogs kyi mthar khyab pa/ /skyabs chen chu lha de la gus pas bstod/ /chos kyi lhun po thos bsam bang rim can/ /bshes gnyen 'dod lha'i tshogs kyi bst-i gnas mchog

/gnas lugs 'gyur med rtogs pa'i lhun 'thug pa/ chos kyi ri bo de la mchog tu bstod/ /mdzad pa'i nyi gzhon phrin las 'od stong can/ / skal ldan rnams kyi pad mtshor shar ba las/ /bslab gsum ge sar mchog tu rgyas pa yis/ /rje 'jug rkang drug bcud kyis rgyas mdzad bstod/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhis gzhan rgyud tshim mdzad nas/ / tshul khrims gsum gyis rang rgyud mdzes par gtams/ /bzod pa gsum gyis dka' thub mthar phyin nas/ /rgyud gsum thugs dgongs rdzogs mdzad de la bstod/ /brtson 'grus gsum gyis don gnyis legs grub nas/ /bsam gtan gsum gyis rig dang mngon shes grub/ /shes rab gsum gyis a ti'i rtse mor son/ /kun bzang chos kyi rje der dad brgyas bstod/ /rim gnyis thabs kyi ye shes stobs dang ldan/ /dus gsum dge ba 'khor gsum dag par bsngo/ /gnas lugs ji ltar shes bya ji snyed mkhyen/ /'jam dbyangs dngos su byon der gus pas bstod/ /byams pa'i spyan gyis 'gro la rtag tu gzigs/ /snying rjes sdug phongs rnams la rtag tu skyong*/ /dga' dang dgyes pas 'gro rnams srid mtshor sgrol/ /dgra dang bu mnyam 'gro don g.yel ba med/ /tshad med bzhi ldan de la gus pas bstod/ /chos dang zang zing g.yab mos gdul bya 'bod/ /snyan smra'i gsung gis nges pa'i chos la sbyor/ /don mthun chos la bags phab a tir sbyor/ / bsdu ba bzhi yis 'gro don mdzad la bstod/ /thos pas sde snod rgyud sde'i don la mkhas/ /bsam pas zab don snying tig yin par rtogs/ bsgoms pas kun tu bzang po'i sa la slebs/ /sangs rgyas bshes gnyen gzugs su sprul la bstod/ /ces pa 'di ni sgo gsum gus pa'i sgo nas/ chos rje rin po che'i mkhyen rab phrin las kyi mdzad pa la thun mong ma yin pa'i sgo nas dad pa'i rlabs g.yo bas mngon par bstod cing gtsug tu khur ba'o/ /grwa phu bsam yas gsang phu skyam gyi phu/

/lha ri brag dang shug gseb o rgyan rdzong*/ /rgya ma grong dang g.yor po gzhung rnams dang*/ /lho brag mon yul rnams su zhabs kyis bcags/ /skal ldan rnams la thar pa'i sa bon btab/ /chos 'khor bskor zhing smin grol rgya cher mdzad/ /tha ma'i mdzad pa mchims phur myang 'das mdzad/ /skyes mchog bzhugs pa'i gnas rnams la phyag 'tshal/ /de ltar legs par sbyar ba'i chos rje rin po che'i rnam par thar pa 'di ni/ lung rig 'dzin pa sprul sku dpal 'byor rgya mtsho dang*/ dad dang gus par ldan pas mnyes pa gsum bsgrubs pa/ dam tshig dang ldan pa'i slob dpon blo gros bzang po dpon slob gnyis kyis yang dang yang du nan gyis bskul bas rang gis rtog tshogs dang*/ rgyal sras rin po che bzod par sku lus dang grib ma bzhin du brten pas/ gsung sgros dang mdzad tshul rnams legs par zhus nas/ 'phri bsnan dang lhag chad med par yi ger btab pa'o// //rta bdun rgyal po'i 'od kyis ma gsal zhing*/ /chu gter chen po'i rlabs kyis ma gsher ba/ /sangs rgyas rabs bdun gyis kyang ma thul ba'i/ /gdul dka' 'dul mdzad skyes mchog rnam thar 'di/ /sgro skur spangs nas legs par bkod pa yin/ /zas gtsang sras po mtshan dpes brgyan pa yi/ /zhabs pad nyi gzhon lta bur dmar ba la/ /gtsug tu khur ba'i lha chen gdong bzhi dang*/ me tog pad+ma'i gnyen la sogs pa 'ang*/ /mthong ba don ldan 'di nyid rtogs gyur na/ /dgyes pa'i spyan 'byed bzang pos mdangs phyung nas/ /mngon par bstod cing dga' ston 'gyed par nges/ /dri med 'od zer 'od stong 'gyed pa 'dra/ /gsang ba snying thig dbang gi rgyal po bzhin/ / dgos 'dod kun 'byung srid zhi'i dbul ba sel/ /'di don rtogs par 'dod pa mang na yang*/ /ston ka'i mtshan mo dngas pa'i mkha' dbyings su/ / ri bong 'dzin gzugs 'od dkar can shar bas/ /dman pa'i skar tshogs kha dog nyams byas ltar/
